gitBootstrapFix.description: Git reader verifies the committed revision first, then converts only either exact missing-path diagnostic to ENOENT. Other Git failures remain fatal. Bootstrap checks the error code, not free-text matching.
gitBootstrapFix.regression: Real temporary Git repository checks absent-on-disk and uncommitted-on-disk files, invalid revision, and unrelated error propagation; 11 source tests passed.

cliImportCycleFix.description: Content auditing imports an inert JSON parser rather than dynamically importing the edition compiler. This removes the CLI module cycle without changing the compiler, compiled HTML, source snapshots or score behavior.
cliImportCycleFix.regression: All 12 edition-source tests passed, including exact parser parity and rejection of executable, duplicate and truncated JSON scripts.
